head_commit.message: MicroRhodoDB v1.6.0 (SQLite databases are Release assets; see BINARIES.md)

website PR-3a: targeted corrections to the Protein Entry page

1. Multi-accession numbering: the record eyebrow shows the actual position of the
   selected source accession ("2 of 2" for B0R5N9) instead of a hardcoded "1 of N".
2. Mol* races: request generations + AbortController in StructureViewer, FIFO mutex
   around all Mol* state changes, single-flight plugin initialisation, dispose on
   unmount (also during initialisation); an outdated structure can no longer replace
   the selected one.
3. Browse exports: filter-based selection_id kept, sort-aware export_id added to all
   file names; the selection manifest lists the same names (fixes the PR-2 issue of
   identical names for different sort orders).
4. Provenance: release models warn that the stored method "ESMCFold2 (full)" disagrees
   with the historical ESMFold note/file name; stored values are shown unchanged.
5. UI: MR_CLD3_017 mini-tree label pushed clear of the highlight outline; Copy link
   keeps the selected section and structure parameters.

Regression tests for each correction (Vitest 94, Playwright 91 passed + 1 skipped,
@live 1, pytest 89). No change to frozen data, trees, releases, the SQLite DB, the
data-export schema/exporter or annotations. See docs/website/PR3A_CORRECTION_REPORT.md.

website PR-1: deterministic scientific data exporter, schema/types, G1 tests, support-label audit

- tools/export_web_data.py: read-only SQLite + refpkg -> static data (v1.6.0); fail-closed exit codes
- web/src/data/schemas/web-data.schema.json (normative) + generated web/src/data/types.ts
- tests/test_web_export.py (31) and tests/test_fetch_release_db.py (4); full suite 87 passed
- web/scripts/fetch_release_db.py + validation-only workflow; CI data source BLOCKED_DATA_SOURCE (Release v1.6.0 absent)
- docs: PR-0a root-child correction, rerooting support-label finding (17 nodes; MR_CLD3_017), as-built contract deviations,
  WEB_DATA_EXPORT.md, PR1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md
No frozen file, classification or phylogeny modified.

head_commit.message:
website PR-2: design system, Home and Browse redesign

- React + TypeScript + Vite app under web/ (base /MicroRhodoDB/site/), typed hash routes,
  route-level lazy loading; per-file PR-1 data, no data.js.
- Design system components (header/mobile menu, footer, badges, stat cards, callouts,
  states, charts with data tables, tree preview, filter panel, results table, export menu).
- Home: hero + universal search, summary cards with denominators, membership and E1-E5
  charts, real 472-tip MR_RT_003 preview with 17 level-1 clades + 2 backbone groups,
  MR_CLD3_017 corrected-support disclosure (IQ-TREE run1 SH-aLRT 50.3 / UFBoot 72).
- Browse: URL filter state, legacy-equivalent filter semantics, sorting, pagination,
  TSV / source FASTA / unique MRDB FASTA / manifest exports; interim record page and
  minimal clade summary; clearly labelled planned pages.
- Data export schema 1.1.0 (additive): 46-column records index, run1 support numbers and
  threshold flag, clade_rule, vocabulary.json. No scientific value changed.
- Tests: pytest 89, Vitest 50, Playwright 46 passed / 1 skipped (local only);
  perf/contrast audit, responsive audit, screenshots, PR2_VALIDATION_REPORT.md.
- CI workflow extended with frontend steps (not yet run on GitHub).
